subject: Geo-processing & transfer summary for Proof-of-Concept
messages:
From: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@finserve.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Legal Team <legal@finserve.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Geo-processing and retention Qs for POC

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Before our internal kickoff I need to confirm a few items for our security and legal teams so we can sign off on the POC environment:

- Where will customer request payloads and LLM prompts be processed (regionally) during the POC?
- Which subprocessors will touch the data for model serving, logging, and monitoring?
- Will any model-related artifacts (KV cache, logs, embeddings) be stored outside the US?
- What's the default retention window for request logs and for generated outputs? Can we shorten it for the POC?
- What's the deletion SLA once we request data removal?

Can you point me to a simple map or matrix so our InfoSec folks can review? If possible we need this by COB Monday so we can move forward.

Best,
Anna Kovacs
Head of Platform Security
FinServe Global

Attachment: none
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@finserve.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Geo-processing and retention Qs for POC

Anna —

Thanks for the clear list. Short answers to unblock you quickly, full matrix to follow from Laura:

- Processing region for POC: US West (primary) with optional failover to US East; no EU/APAC routing for the POC unless requested.
- Subprocessors: serving runtime on our dedicated cluster (Redwood-managed GPUs), logging/metrics via Datadog (subprocessor), and S3-compatible storage (partner-managed). I will attach a detailed inventory.
- Model artifacts: by default KV cache and transient inference data remain in-memory or ephemeral storage in the same region; persistent artifacts (aggregated logs/embeddings) are stored in US West.
- Retention: default request logs = 30 days, generated output persistence (by default) = 90 days; we can shorten both for POC to 7 / 30 days respectively if you need.
- Deletion SLA: standard policy is 30 days for full purge after a deletion request; for POC we can commit to 7 days.

I asked Laura to share a one-page matrix and a simple processing map (PDF) — see her email below. If that doesn't cover anything Legal needs, loop Neha and we'll produce the formal language.

Regards,
Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@finserve.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Processing map + subprocessor inventory for FinServe POC

Anna / team —

Attaching a concise inventory and a geo-processing map for the POC. Summary below; see attachments (subprocessor_inventory.csv, residency_map.pdf).

High-level processing flows (POC default):
- Ingest: customer requests hit the Redwood edge in US West (us-west-2) and are routed to the POC serving pool in the same region.
- Inference: model inference executed on Redwood-managed GPU nodes in us-west-2 (primary). Requests are routed to US East (us-east-1) only if the primary pool is at capacity or during planned maintenance (failover).
- Caching & transient state: KV cache is memory-backed per GPU host and does not persist to multi-region storage. If a cache snapshot is exported for telemetry it is written to US West object storage.
- Logging/metrics: aggregated logs and anonymized metrics are forwarded to Datadog (Datadog, Inc.) with ingestion in US West; Datadog may have cross-region replication under their control for operational resilience.
- Embeddings & analytics: persistent embeddings generated for evaluation are written to our partner object store in US West by default; cross-region replication is disabled for the POC.

Subprocessor list (high-level):
- Datadog — monitoring/metrics (ingest region: US West)
- S3-Partner (managed object store) — persisted logs/embeddings (US West)
- Cloud provider networking & load balancing (AWS) — regional services (us-west-2, us-east-1 for failover)

Cross-border testing: no EU/APAC transfer is configured for the POC. If you later enable global routing, we will provide a transfer map and list of subprocessors by region and implement contractual safeguards (SCCs or equivalent where applicable).

Retention & deletion options for POC:
- Request logs: default 30 days, POC option 7 days.
- Generated outputs: default 90 days, POC option 30 days.
- Deletion: we support account-level and request-level deletion. After a formal deletion request we purge persistent artifacts within 7 days for POC (audit trail retained as metadata for 90 days, per audit needs).

If you want the legal wording for contractual annexes (SCCs, data processing terms), I've looped Neha.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Anna Kovacs <anna.kovacs@finserve.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 10:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Processing map + subprocessor inventory for FinServe POC — legal text and deletion SLA

Anna / team —

Thanks for the request. Quick legal clarifications and proposed contract language we can include in an addendum:

1) Data residency commitments (POC): Redwood will process customer request payloads and transient inference data in the region specified in the order (us-west-2). We will not route data outside the specified region for the POC except for explicit failover to us-east-1 which also resides in the United States.

2) Subprocessors: Redwood maintains a subprocessor registry (attached as subprocessor_inventory.csv). Each subprocessor relationship is governed by written contracts that include EU SCCs where required and contractual obligations to limit processing to the agreed regions.

3) Retention & deletion: Proposed addendum wording:
   - "Retention: Redwood will retain request logs for a period specified in the Order (POC default 7 days). Generated outputs will be retained for the period specified in the Order (POC default 30 days)."
   - "Deletion: Redwood will initiate permanent deletion of persistent artifacts within 7 calendar days of a verified deletion request. Proof of deletion will be provided upon request in the form of an exportable audit record."

4) Evidence & audits: For POC customers we provide a compliance pack (SOC 2 summary, subprocessor list, residency map). Full SOC 2 reports can be provided under an NDA and an executed DPA.

Attached: data-retention-terms.docx (legal wording), and I can generate a short one-page annex with SCC references if you need it for EU reviewers.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
